decision: Preserve named dormant app and VPS modules
why: The user may enable them again
The only existing Ollama host assignment is the laptop false setting
Latest commit makes modules/apps/agents the source of global instructions and skills

decision: Retain XWayland and the X11 SDDM greeter
why: Active apps still need X compatibility and the NVIDIA greeter choice is intentional

decision: Localize secret declarations without deleting dormant service values
why: Disabled services should keep encrypted recovery data without decrypting it at runtime

decision: Run trusted npm package install scripts
why: Claude and OpenCode require postinstall scripts

decision: Use an OS file lock for npm updates
why: A directory lock can survive interruption and block every later update

decision: Restore script-owned OpenAI and OpenRouter secrets
why: The rebuild wizard and Twitter helper read secret files outside Nix expressions

decision: Use one module root and three role profiles
why: Both personal hosts repeated the same app policy while Darwin had separate root wiring

decision: Keep workstation-only CLI packages off macOS
why: Adding Linux utility packages to Darwin would change command behavior
